rules.statement: A party who remains on the record without participating in the trial cannot be considered an aggrieved party.
rules.supporting_quote: A party qua Appellants who missed the opportunity of availing himself of putting forward his case in the original court cannot be treated on par with a victim of an offence who is so desirous of taking advantage of Section 260 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No. 15 of 1979.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 25 of the Partition Law, No. 21 of 1977
